description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 20, and is marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio", also has a linear scale, spans from 0.0 to 0.8, and is marked at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line represents the "sparsity ratio before gate" and starts at approximately 0.08 at layer 0, remaining relatively steady until layer 10, then gradually increases to around 0.14 at layer 20. The orange dotted line, representing the "sparsity ratio after gate", begins at about 0.9 at layer 0, sharply declines to around 0.2 by layer 5, and then gradually decreases further to approximately 0.16 at layer 10, before slightly increasing to about 0.25 at layer 20. The green dashed line, representing the "sparsity ratio after average gate", starts at roughly 0.85 at layer 0, drops to around 0.2 by layer 3, continues to decrease to approximately 0.16 at layer 5, and then remains relatively stable until layer 10, after which it gradually increases to about 0.2 at layer 20.
